---
name: Bug report
about: Describe a problem with evidence and a clear expected result.
type: Bug
---

<!-- Guidance for the author. Delete these comments before submitting; they stay in
the text even though the page hides them.
- Keep Current behavior, Reproduction and Expected behavior; delete any other
  section, heading included, that would add nothing.
- Make the issue understandable on its own. Say each thing once; if it fits several
  sections, choose one.
- Say what you observed, what was reported (and by whom) and what you assume; mark
  anything without evidence as unverified. Do not invent missing details.
- Say whether the reproduction was run, reported or not yet attempted.
- Label a proposed fix as a suggestion and keep it out of the criteria unless it
  has been agreed. Mark a criterion that is your own addition as proposed.
- Use the names found in the code or product, and summarize any source the reader
  cannot open. -->

## Current behavior and impact
<!-- What happens now, who or what it affects, and when it started if known. -->

## Reproduction and evidence
<!-- Steps or input and the actual result, or say that there is no reliable
reproduction. Include exact errors, logs and the environment; redact secrets. -->

## Expected behavior and fix criteria
<!-- What should happen instead, and where that expectation comes from. Use `- [ ]`
items if there are several. -->

## Investigation so far
<!-- Confirmed findings, hypotheses, and fixes tried or ruled out. -->

## How to verify
<!-- How the fix will be shown to work. Delete this section if re-running the
reproduction is the whole test. -->

## Dependencies and open questions
<!-- Parent or blocking issues (also set as GitHub relationships), and unanswered
questions with what each one blocks. -->
